consequence.statement: Existing NodeClaim objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all NodeClaim objects) and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After this upgrade, run the storage version migration for nodeclaims.karpenter.sh: re-write all NodeClaim objects so they are stored at v1, then update status.storedVersions (drop v1beta1) before upgrading to the later release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the NodeClaim CRD (nodeclaims.karpenter.sh) changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing NodeClaim objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and a storage version migration (re-writing all objects) plus an update of status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
